# sagittarius

drivers, terminals & small simulations.

I'm sagittarius, I also go by @arinaholic and @dummy3ye. I send patches to the Linux kernel, build embedded systems and simulations, and write fast tools for the terminal.

## Work

Stuff I made. Mostly open source, mostly CLI/TUI, and a few websites and simulations.

- notebook — scientific publishing. Built with Bun, Next.js, marked and KaTeX. https://github.com/dummy3ye/notebook
- blackholegl — a black hole in C++ and OpenGL; a simulation of Gargantua. 6 stars, 2 forks. https://github.com/dummy3ye/blackholegl
- lostdock — a GUI dorking tool made for OSINT. https://github.com/dummy3ye/lostdock
- shell — my desktop shell, built with Quickshell. https://github.com/dummy3ye/shell
- waytosea — a pastel theme based on a stormy sea. https://github.com/dummy3ye/waytosea

Smaller things:

- yanker — downloads videos from YouTube and 500+ other sites from a single TUI. https://github.com/dummy3ye/yanker
- anily — a blazing fast TUI for watching anime, in Rust. https://github.com/dummy3ye/anily
- topscreen — a GUI and press feature for your screen over ADB and scrcpy. https://github.com/dummy3ye/topscreen
- libcreate — finally adds an "e" to the Unix creat(). https://github.com/dummy3ye/libcreate
- prism — a pretty, cozy and frosty Neovim configuration. https://github.com/dummy3ye/prism
- flamer — https://github.com/dummy3ye/flamer
- forest — https://github.com/dummy3ye/forest

There's more on my other site: https://home.osky.dpdns.org

## Kernel

I send patches to the Linux kernel, and test a few drivers along the way.

What I send: mostly small fixes in drivers — wifi, media, usb, uvc and staging.

What I test: Intel backlight, rtw88 and uvc. I test and contribute to all three.

Everything is public:

- All my patches on lore.kernel.org — https://lore.kernel.org/all/?q=reza1234khan1234@gmail.com
- Kernel source tree — https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git
- Patch docs — https://docs.kernel.org/process/submitting-patches.html

## Setup

What I write with, and what I write on.

Languages: C, TypeScript and Python, plus a bit of Rust, Go, C++ and Lua.

Daily setup:

- system: Arch Linux
- desktop: Hyprland with Waybar
- terminal: Kitty and fish
- editor: Neovim, with my own config called prism — https://github.com/dummy3ye/prism
